name: GlowWrite AI – AI Content Writer, Featured Image Generator & SEO Assistant
author: motiraj

sections.description:
Welcome to GlowWrite AI, the ultimate AI-powered content writer, featured image generator, and SEO assistant engineered natively for WordPress Gutenberg and Classic Editors.

Whether you run a high-traffic affiliate blog, an e-commerce store, or an agency publishing dozens of articles daily, GlowWrite AI cuts drafting time by 90% without sacrificing editorial depth, search intent, or Google E-E-A-T guidelines.

🚀 Works Instantly Out-of-the-Box (No API Key Required to Start)

Unlike traditional AI plugins that block you with an immediate paywall or force you to navigate complex developer consoles before typing a single word, GlowWrite AI includes Free Instant Mode powered out-of-the-box by Pollinations AI.

Activate the plugin and immediately generate complete, well-researched blog posts, outlines, and photorealistic featured images with 1 click. Zero credit cards. Zero API configuration needed to begin.

⚡ Simultaneous Multi-Model Switching (OpenAI, Gemini & Claude BYOK)

Prefer industry-leading commercial models? GlowWrite AI lets you save your own API keys simultaneously and switch models on the fly directly inside the editor:
* Google Gemini: Fast, dynamic, highly intelligent, and offers a generous free tier via Google AI Studio.
* OpenAI (ChatGPT): High-precision drafting with GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, and DALL-E 3 image generation.
* Anthropic (Claude): Nuanced, natural human prose powered by Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Haiku.
* Free Instant Mode: Zero-configuration community AI powered by Pollinations for unlimited free experimentation.

🛠️ Floating AI Tools Dock (Visible on Posts & Pages)

Never search through hidden sidebars again. GlowWrite AI docks a sleek, non-intrusive floating toolbar right on the editor screen for both Posts and Pages:
* 📝 Full Article: Complete article draft with intro, structured headings, body, and key takeaways.
* 🎯 SEO Post: Keyword-targeted SEO article crafted around user search intent.
* 📑 Outline: 3 click-worthy H1 title options and complete H2/H3 subheadings.
* 📌 Insert TOC: 1-click anchor-linked Table of Contents inserted at the top of the post.
* 🔍 Meta Desc: 150–160 character SEO snippet synced to Yoast, Rank Math, and post excerpts.
* 🎨 AI Image: Generates an AI Featured Image and attaches it to the post in 1 click.
* ✍️ Polish: Quick shortcut to rephrase, improve readability, or expand sections.
* ⚙️ Sidebar: Toggles open the full GlowWrite AI assistant sidebar.
* Minimize Toggle: Easily collapses into a compact floating pill whenever you want a minimalist writing canvas.

✍️ In-Context Block Toolbar Assistant (BlockControls)

Writing directly in Gutenberg? Whenever you select any Paragraph, Heading, or Quote block, the ✨ GlowWrite AI dropdown appears right in the block’s floating toolbar:
* ✍️ Polish & Improve Readability
* ➕ Expand with More Detail
* ✂️ Simplify & Shorten
* 🔄 Rewrite / Paraphrase
* 📌 Fix Grammar & Flow
Update and refine your prose in real time without losing your writing flow.

🎨 Automated AI Featured Image Generation

Never publish an article without an eye-catching header image again. GlowWrite AI automatically analyzes your post topic, designs an E-E-A-T compliant concept, generates a high-resolution featured image using Flux or DALL-E 3, and safely sideloads it into your WordPress Media Library with optimized Alt text.

🎯 Automated SEO Headings & Title Optimizer

Stop guessing what Google wants. GlowWrite AI inspects your primary query and generates:
* 3 click-worthy, search-intent optimized H1 post title options (under 60 characters).
* Complete structured H2 and H3 heading outlines with actionable bullet points.
* 1-click direct insertion of selected titles and heading blocks into Gutenberg or Classic Editor.

📌 1-Click Anchor-Linked Table of Contents (TOC) with Real-Time Heading Sync

Boost your organic click-through rates and Core Web Vitals UX. With a single click, GlowWrite AI scans every H2 and H3 heading currently in your post, assigns smooth HTML anchor IDs, and generates a clean, semantic Table of Contents block right below your introductory hook. Our dynamic heading synchronization engine guarantees that TOC links always match your article content 100% without ghost headings.

🔍 1-Click SEO Meta Description Generator

Generate compelling 150–160 character meta descriptions that entice searchers to click through. Includes live character counter badges, a 1-click Copy button, and seamless automatic population for:
* Core WordPress Post Excerpt
* Yoast SEO (_yoast_wpseo_metadesc)
* Rank Math (rank_math_description)
* All in One SEO (AIOSEO) & SEOPress

📄 Full WordPress Page & Custom Post Type Support

GlowWrite AI isn’t limited to standard blog posts. Generate and optimize content for WordPress Pages (post_type=page), WooCommerce products, and custom post types. Access quick AI generation from the WordPress admin menu (Pages → Add New with AI) or right beside the “Add New Page” button.

🔒 Enterprise-Grade AES-256 API Key Security

Your private API keys are never stored in plain text. GlowWrite AI utilizes cryptographic AES-256-CBC encryption using your unique site salt.

External services

This plugin connects to third-party AI APIs to generate text content and images based on your prompts. No user data is transmitted without explicit user action in the editor or settings:

  • Pollinations AI: Used for Free Instant Mode text generation and free community featured image generation (Flux, Flux Realism, 3D, Turbo). It sends prompt text to generate content without requiring an API key. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
  • Google Gemini: Used for text generation when selected. It transmits your prompt text and system instructions to Google Generative AI endpoints. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
  • OpenAI: Used for text generation (GPT-4o) and DALL-E image generation when selected. It sends your prompt data to OpenAI. Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.
  • Anthropic: Used for text generation (Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Haiku) when selected. It sends your prompt data to Anthropic. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the glowwrite-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins directory by searching for GlowWrite AI.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in your WordPress admin.
  3. Open any post or page, or go to Posts → Add New with AI. GlowWrite AI is ready to draft immediately in Free Instant Mode!
  4. (Optional) Navigate to GlowWrite AI → Settings to connect your OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude API keys.
sections.faq:
Is GlowWrite AI free to use?

Yes! GlowWrite AI includes Free Instant Mode out-of-the-box powered by Pollinations AI. You do not need a paid subscription or API key to start generating articles, outlines, and images.

Is GlowWrite AI tested with the latest WordPress version?

Yes! GlowWrite AI is fully tested, certified, and optimized for WordPress 7.1.4 and PHP 8.0–8.3+.

Can I use GlowWrite AI on Pages as well as Posts?

Yes! GlowWrite AI provides complete support for WordPress Pages (post_type=page), WooCommerce products, and custom post types, including dedicated “Add New with AI” menu shortcuts and full on-canvas toolbars.

Can I use my own OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude API keys?

Yes! GlowWrite AI supports simultaneous multi-provider storage. You can save keys for Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude at the same time and switch between them in the post editor on the fly.

Where do I get free Gemini, OpenAI, or Claude API keys?

  • Google Gemini: Free tier available at aistudio.google.com.
  • OpenAI: platform.openai.com.
  • Anthropic: console.anthropic.com.

Does it support Yoast SEO and Rank Math?

Yes! When generating articles or meta descriptions, GlowWrite AI automatically populates focus keywords, SEO titles, and meta descriptions into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and standard WordPress excerpts.

Are my API keys secure?

Yes! All API keys are encrypted using AES-256-CBC with your unique WordPress site salt before saving to the database.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.4: Verified 100% compatible with the latest WordPress 7.1 release.
  • New: Floating AI Tools Dock: Visible on-screen toolbar anchored on both Post and Page edit screens with 1-click tools for Full Article, SEO Post, Outline, Insert TOC, Meta Description, AI Image, Polish, and Sidebar.
  • New: Block Toolbar Assistant: Gutenberg BlockControls integration to polish, expand, shorten, rewrite, and fix grammar directly from the block toolbar on any paragraph, heading, or quote.
  • New: 1-Click AI Featured Image Generator (POST /glowwrite-ai/v1/generate-image) with automatic Media Library sideloading and assignment.
  • New: Dynamic TOC Synchronization Engine: Automatically generates and reconciles Table of Contents from actual article headings, preventing phantom or mismatched links.
  • New: Full WordPress Page Support: Added “✨ Add New with AI” submenus and list action buttons under both Posts and Pages (edit.php?post_type=page).
  • New: Zero-Config “Free Instant Mode” powered out-of-the-box by Pollinations AI for both text drafting and featured image generation with zero API key required.
  • New: Simultaneous Multi-Provider Configuration: Store API keys for Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude at the same time.
  • New: In-Editor Model Switcher: Change AI providers and models dynamically inside Gutenberg and Classic Editor without leaving the post.
  • New: Automated SEO Headings & Title Optimizer: Generate 3 high-intent H1 title choices and complete H2/H3 outlines with 1-click insertion into the editor.
  • New: 1-Click SEO Meta Description Generator: Creates 150–160 character descriptions with live character counters, a copy button, and auto-sync to Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and excerpts.
  • New: Classic Editor Quick-Tools Banner: Prominent visible tools bar above TinyMCE and next to Add Media button.
  • New: 3-Step Guided Onboarding Notice: Admin setup card with direct deep-links to free keys and live “Test Connection” AJAX verification.
  • New: Non-Intrusive Growth Review Loop: Polite, dismissible review prompt triggered only after 3 successful generations.
  • Enhancement: Removed all editor blocking screens; non-configured keys display helpful guidance badges instead of error walls.
  • Enhancement: Graceful image generation fallback preventing post creation failures if an image model quota is exceeded.
  • Security: Cryptographic AES-256 encryption preserved with backward compatibility for v1.0.0 stored keys, nonce verification, and permission checks.

1.0.0

  • New: Initial public release on WordPress.org.
  • New: Integrated AI writing assistant for WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg) and Classic Editor (TinyMCE).
  • New: Multi-provider API architecture supporting OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini.
  • New: AI Featured Image generation with automatic media library sideloading.
  • New: Tone of voice selector (Professional, Casual, Informative, Persuasive, Humorous).
  • New: Content rewriting, polishing, shortening, and expansion tools.
  • Security: AES-256-CBC database encryption for stored API keys.
  • Core: Settings panel, admin documentation screen, and WooCommerce product description generator.
